valve.label: Turn the ball valve
valve.caption: Grasp the lever, swing it through its quarter turn, leave it shut.

lamp.label: Change the lamp
lamp.caption: Unscrew the bulb out of its socket, hold it clear, screw it back home.

breaker.label: Flip the circuit breaker
breaker.caption: Close the gripper and sweep the toggle across to its other stop.
